item.title: 1,300 bytes, three C2s in two weeks
item.description:
A static ARM ELF of 1,300 bytes, echoed onto telnet-reachable devices. Static analysis only.

What it does

No libc, six syscalls:

  1. socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM)
  2. connect to an IPv4 stored as 4 raw bytes in .data, port 2345
  3. write one byte: 0x04
  4. read 128 bytes at a time and write each chunk to stdout
  5. close, exit(5)

The server sends a binary; the stub just pipes it out. The dropper does the rest:

item.title: 75 days of honeypot captures
item.description:
2 September to 17 November 2026. 797 files, 681 MB. Static analysis; superior was also run in an isolated lab. No attacker host was contacted. Families with their own post: superior, systemd-baby, the 1,300-byte ARM stub.

The haul

398 ELF binaries, ~215 shell scripts, 40 archives, 108 tiny or junk files, the rest HTML error pages and empties. By month: September 154, October 340, November 301.

item.title: superior: a build that kept its debug info
item.description:
superior is a musl C bot for routers, DVRs and Android TV boxes. eFeSpain reported it first and in depth: Superior series, chapters 35–37. This post is everything I found, including what they already covered. Items marked New are not in their reporting or abuse.ch as of 18 November. Static analysis, plus two runs in an isolated lab on 18 November.

Summary

FindingStatus
ARM build with DWARF debug info, ~90 source module namesNew (binary on VirusTotal from 5 Nov; no public analysis found)
bricker.c (bricker_lock, bricker_taunt_download)New, code only; not confirmed reachable
Install telemetry on 195.178.110[.]91:18081New
CNC command set: framing, 8 control opcodes, attack-command layout, 39 vector idsNew; eFeSpain give no command format
Passive decoder, and a network signature on the announcement’s constant bytesNew
C2 domain ilovefemboyssomuch.duckdns[.]org, UDP 5823 benchmark, [BOOT]/[SYSINFO]/[SELF] report formatsNew
Mesh seen running in a lab: on by default in both builds, bots link on TCP 443; wire format, keys, 16 message typesNew; eFeSpain found it switched off and never saw it run
Neither build dialled its CNC in the lab; in the debug build nothing opens the CNC socketNew
SWR1 greeting on 443, .swarm_peers, SCARE/KILL mesh commands, HYDRA on UDP 8346, [BOOK]/[CATALOG] reportseFeSpain ch. 36

item.title: systemd-baby: 180 places to come back from
item.description:
An armv7l bot named systemd-baby, delivered over telnet from 77.239.124[.]172 on 4 November. Static analysis only.

Known vs. new

Status (17 Nov)
armv7l hashNot on MalwareBazaar, ThreatFox or VirusTotal
x86_64 URL on the same hostOn URLhaus since 4 Nov (zensatori)
Related x86-64 build dcdfb586…MalwareBazaar 18 Oct (c2hunter). It installs as nyx.service, not systemd-baby
Three of its decoy domainsOn ThreatFox as Mirai C2 (NDA0E, 18 Oct)
77.239.124[.]0/24Hosting covered by eFeSpain

I found no write-up of the family. New here: the persistence catalogue, the decoys, and the armv7l build.
